design_order: Designed from the preceding source-only result (correct assignment 41/41 but both single captions correct 32/41), before reading any target outcomes of either new study. The previous 44-pair panel is development.
mechanism: For scores d1=S(a,t_a)-S(b,t_a) and d2=S(a,t_b)-S(b,t_b), one physical-pair offset that maximizes both directions' worst margin is b=(d1+d2)/2. Intrinsic language separation is g=(d1-d2)/2. Distil b into a scalar per-slot correction from the current caption alone. Predict S(i,t)-q(i,t). The target uses just the four original v1 boxes, one sentence and one forward.
fitting: 181 eligible natural Waymo TRAIN pairs before four-slot truncation. Fit q on both sentence-specific frozen second-round subject feature differences (96 inputs, no intercept needed). Minimize mean squared error to the same measured b for both sentences. Scale each coordinate by its source RMS contrast, discard zero columns, use ridge equal to mean diagonal information. No target tuning. Paired-bias is primary. Supply the same comparisons, true labels and frozen evidence to all controls.
controls: Independent logistic learns an additive scalar on the exact same standardized features with the same ridge penalty. Constant-separation ridge uses the same targets as paired-bias except g is replaced by global source mean g. Broken-bias keeps true individual directions but permutes the other direction within the previous category/difficulty-matched arrays. Rank-only predicts b from one-hot slot ordinal with identical regression. No target labels, no geometry or candidate changes.
switch_calibration: Report raw as primary. Supplement all 96D variants at a common native switch count on 160 original source holdout sentences using scale in [0,1], choose the smallest of the four counts. Zero target-calibrated budgets. Quantify unobservable source switch-rate saturation explicitly.
external_source_probe: Precommitted fresh recording confirmation on Waymo ordinary VAL only. Use all qualifying recordings disjoint from both training and previous calibration recordings. At most two distinct physical frames per recording, one natural same-class pair per frame. Hash-based, no model scores for selection, both descriptions present in the historical ordinary roster. Shared four boxes from both sentences' top four via the previous deterministic merge. Source GT is used for sampling the cohort and post-prediction identity matching only. No use of these outcomes to refit. Exclude repeated content across probes.
primary_results: Both sentences independently rank the true physical endpoint above its opponent on the fresh source probe; corresponding both-winner-of-four; target single-sentence Acc50, Acc25 and mIoU with paired rescues/harms across both ordinary Waymo-origin directions. Check broken and independent controls, recording concentration and source switching. All negatives and uncovered cases remain in unconditional denominators. The teacher using both opposite captions is an oracle diagnosis, not a deployable method. Neither two distinct subjects nor positive assignment suffices to verify role binding within one sentence. Leave production v1 and FINAL untouched.
